item.title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. No photo—use a plain white leather low-top with white laces and a white sole, no logo. Three moving shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep all captions at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won't cover them.

item.tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

answer_sheet.Product and reference: No photo; generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
answer_sheet.Shot style: Three moving product shots; backgrounds, lighting and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”.
answer_sheet.Caption placement: Every caption, including its full text bounds, must stay at least 15% from each side and 20% from the top and bottom.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Your call; make it easy to read on a phone.
answer_sheet.Format, duration and audio: One silent 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

args.name: Everyday Pair — Silent Vertical Sneaker Ad

style.prompt:
Create a polished 15-second vertical 9:16 minimalist sneaker advertisement. SILENT: no audio, speech, music, or sound effects. Exactly three moving shots, 5 seconds each, with clean hard cuts at 5 and 10 seconds. Maintain identical product design across all shots: a plain white leather low-top sneaker, white laces, plain white rubber sole, absolutely no logo, branding, letters, symbols, or colored details anywhere on the shoe. Premium photorealistic studio product cinematography, soft shadows, warm off-white seamless background, beautifully detailed white leather. No people. The sneaker must remain anatomically consistent and not morph.
SHOT 1, 0–5 seconds: three-quarter hero view of the sneaker on a low off-white plinth; camera slowly orbits around the shoe with clear parallax. Caption exactly: “Meet your everyday pair”.
SHOT 2, 5–10 seconds: smooth moving close-up tracking along the white leather upper, white laces and white sole, highlighting clean construction. Caption exactly: “Clean look. Easy style.”
SHOT 3, 10–15 seconds: return to a complete side/three-quarter product hero view, shoe on a slowly rotating pedestal while camera gently pulls back. Caption exactly: “Shop now”.
CAPTION REQUIREMENTS: Render exact crisp, correctly spelled dark charcoal sans-serif typography, moderate large readable size, centered horizontally, stationary on screen during its shot. Only that shot's caption visible; never show previous or next captions simultaneously. All glyphs including punctuation must stay strictly within x=15%–85% of frame width and y=20%–80% of frame height. Use a narrower text box x=20%–80% and y=25%–40% to provide additional safety margin; wrap long captions to two centered lines if necessary. Keep the sneaker primarily in lower-middle frame below caption, without obscuring the text. No other text, no watermarks, no decorative text or borders. Accurate captions and strict safe-area placement are essential.
